ios.desc:
With automatic daily check-ins, you only “Mark if Missed,” making it simple to build good habits or break bad ones while focusing on your goals.
Build better habits and stay motivated with OnTrack Goal Habit Tracker – the app that makes habit tracking effortless.

OnTrack Goal Habit Tracker helps you create routines that last. Whether you want to exercise, eat healthier, study more, or cut bad habits, OnTrack keeps you accountable with streaks, progress history, and charts that show your growth over time.

Key Features

Habit Tracking with Autopilot
• No daily check-in required – habits track automatically every day.  
• Just “Mark if Missed” to stay on course.  
• Build habits or break habits with ease.  
• Turn goals into lasting routines.  

Streaks & Progress
• Track streaks, completion rates, and detailed stats.  
• Visualize your journey with colorful charts, grids, and history.  
• View weekly and monthly progress at a glance.  
• Stay accountable with habit streaks and goal tracking.  

Customizable & Flexible
• Add icons for fitness, wellness, diet, study, and more.  
• Review history to spot trends and celebrate wins.  
• Heatmap, Calendar, Weekly, Monthly, and Stats views.  
• Grid charts and detailed statistics for each goal or habit.  

Smart & Secure
• iCloud sync keeps your habits and goals updated across devices.  
• Simple, clean design for effortless tracking.  

Why OnTrack?
Inspired by proven methods like *Atomic Habits*, OnTrack blends simplicity with powerful habit-building tools. With autopilot check-ins, streaks, and beautiful charts, you’ll stay motivated and consistent. Build habits, break bad ones, and track goals without the hassle of daily logging.  

Premium Features
• Unlimited habits and goals*  
• Extra activity icons*  
• Advanced charts & summary stats*  

*Available with OnTrack Premium
